     1	;; Test 9: Mutual recursion - even? and odd?
     2	
     3	(define (even? n)
     4	  (if (= n 0)
     5	      #t
     6	      (odd? (- n 1))))
     7	
     8	(define (odd? n)
     9	  (if (= n 0)
    10	      #f
    11	      (even? (- n 1))))
    12	
    13	(display "Testing even? and odd?:")
    14	(newline)
    15	
    16	(define (test-number n)
    17	  (progn
    18	    (display n)
    19	    (display " is ")
    20	    (if (even? n)
    21	        (display "even")
    22	        (display "odd"))
    23	    (newline)))
    24	
    25	(test-number 0)
    26	(test-number 1)
    27	(test-number 10)
    28	(test-number 15)
    29	(test-number 100)

    31	;; Mutual recursion with lists
    32	(define (take-even lst)
    33	  (if (null? lst)
    34	      '()
    35	      (cons (car lst) (take-odd (cdr lst)))))
    36	
    37	(define (take-odd lst)
    38	  (if (null? lst)
    39	      '()
    40	      (take-even (cdr lst))))
    41	
    42	(display "Alternate elements of (1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8):")
    43	(newline)
    44	(display "Even positions: ")
    45	(display (take-even '(1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8)))
    46	(newline)
    47	(display "Odd positions: ")
    48	(display (take-odd '(1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8)))
    49	(newline)
